error_reason: The Planner incorrectly determined that the visible search snippet in Step 11 was insufficient to answer the query, triggering a redundant search. This decision was fatal because Step 12 had already successfully loaded the full article containing the explicit 'Education and Career' section with the answer (McMaster University), yet the Planner failed to inspect this newly available evidence before proceeding. This failure to verify loaded content propagated uncertainty and wasted steps, directly leading to the wrong final conclusion.

hypotheses.rationale: The Planner states that the visible excerpt does not confirm the education and decides to run a redundant search, ignoring the fact that Step 12 (which occurred almost simultaneously in the trace context) loaded the full article containing the explicit 'Education and Career' section with the university name. This failure to verify the loaded content before proceeding to new searches propagated the error of uncertainty to Step 13.

However, Step 12 successfully loaded the specific article (https://www.thecanadianencyclopedia.ca/en/article/matt-cohen). Step 13 (the follow-up) acknowledges that Step 12 loaded the 'Education and Career' area containing the exact answer ('BA 1964... from McMaster University'), proving Step 11 incorrectly discarded valid, immediately available evidence by relying only on the initial generic search result rather than inspecting the newly loaded target page.
